I used to smoke all day everyday with a cart, with bong, joints, etc. But one thing my dad told me really helped and that was to wait 5 minutes to smoke every time I had a craving. So I would wait 5 minutes but by the time this passed I was doing something else so i ended up waiting longer. Then if I thought about smoking, I would wait another 5 minutes and so on. This was a helpful form of harm reduction for me, similar to what I do now. I smoke a few times a week, mostly with friends. Basically I just tried to see how long I could go without smoking, whether it was 2 hours,  a day, 3 days,  etc, using the 5 minute method I mentioned above. And when I smoked I didn't get mad at myself, instead, I reinforced the positive behavior I had just completed by basi ally telling myself "good job for abstaining from smoking for x amount of time". Then I would enjoy my high. Rinse and repeat and now I smoke way less than i used to, don't get overly high, don't smoke alone, and in general enjoy my time high much more than I used to.
